title: Supply Chain Operations Management
overview: Weak supply chains can disrupt the flow of goods and services, leading to increased costs and decreased customer satisfaction. Additionally, ineffective operations can have detrimental effects on society and the environment. This course focuses on practices that strengthen and sustain supply chains in the face of change.

We begin by examining the characteristics of robust and sustainable supply chains, followed by an overview of product and logistics design principles to optimize performance. We also delve into continuity planning strategies for managing supply chain risks and disruptions. Finally, we will discuss how to enhance supply chain resilience through effective stakeholder engagement and progressive sustainability principles.
audience: This course is designed for supply chain professionals across various functions, including planning, procurement, warehousing, transportation, logistics, and inventory management.
methodology: The course incorporates a mix of individual and team exercises, assessments, case studies, games, videos, and discussion forums.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify the key elements of strong supply chains that support continuity and sustainability
Outline best practices for supply chain design to achieve optimal performance
Participate in continuity planning to effectively manage supply chain interruptions
Develop strategies for stakeholder engagement to enhance supply stream resilience
Recognize the importance of ethical, sustainable, and responsible practices as foundational to strong supply chains
